package main

// The receipt position-field corpus (RB9-F6 TS port, step 3; the validator review V-P): StartIndex, EndIndex and End of a merkle.Receipt are read by no
// verifier (Receipt.Validate recomputes Start through Entries to Anchor only), so a receipt with ANY value of those three fields must be judged by its
// Start, Entries and Anchor alone - and a value of the wrong type is a refusal of the document like any other member of the wrong type. Every document that
// carries a genesis link (the corpus of genesisspell) is given, at EVERY place it carries a receipt that this rule reaches (evidence.genesisLink,
// evidence.receipt, evidence.anchor.receipt, every evidence.links[i], every evidence.anchors[*].receipt), each of:
//
//	end        "00", "deadbeef", the receipt's own anchor, "", null, 5 (a number: wrong type)
//	startIndex 0, 1, -1, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775808 (past int64), null, "x" (wrong type)
//	endIndex   1, 9223372036854775807, true (wrong type)
//	all three  startIndex 7, endIndex 3, end "ab"
//
// A case is a list of byte edits of the base file (the member written at the end of the receipt object), judged from the text; each shard is its own file,
// bytes-cases-receiptpos-<i>.json.gz, consumed by test/s3-bytes-receiptpos-<i+1>.test.ts through the same consumer as every byte corpus.
//
//	XTS_SHARD=<i>/4 ./xtsgen -fixtures $S3 -out <dir> receiptpos      (i = 0..3)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

type posKind struct{ name, member string }

func posKinds(anchor string) []posKind {
	return []posKind{
		{"end-00", `"end":"00"`},
		{"end-deadbeef", `"end":"deadbeef"`},
		{"end-anchor", `"end":"` + anchor + `"`},
		{"end-empty", `"end":""`},
		{"end-null", `"end":null`},
		{"end-number", `"end":5`},
		{"startIndex-0", `"startIndex":0`},
		{"startIndex-1", `"startIndex":1`},
		{"startIndex-neg", `"startIndex":-1`},
		{"startIndex-int64max", `"startIndex":9223372036854775807`},
		{"startIndex-past-int64", `"startIndex":9223372036854775808`},
		{"startIndex-null", `"startIndex":null`},
		{"startIndex-string", `"startIndex":"x"`},
		{"endIndex-1", `"endIndex":1`},
		{"endIndex-int64max", `"endIndex":9223372036854775807`},
		{"endIndex-bool", `"endIndex":true`},
		{"all-three", `"startIndex":7,"endIndex":3,"end":"ab"`},
	}
}

func receiptPosCases(doc []byte) []spellCase {
	w := &objWalker{b: doc}
	w.value(0, "", "", -1, false)
	var out []spellCase
	for i := range w.out {
		n := w.out[i]
		if n.kind != 'o' {
			continue
		}
		c := n.class
		reach := c == "evidence.genesisLink" || c == "evidence.receipt" || c == "evidence.anchor.receipt" || c == "evidence.links[*]" || (strings.HasPrefix(c, "evidence.anchors.{url}") && strings.HasSuffix(c, ".receipt") && strings.Count(c, ".") == 3)
		if !reach {
			continue
		}
		var rc map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(doc[n.vs:n.ve], &rc); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		anchor, _ := rc["anchor"].(string)
		where := fmt.Sprintf("%s@%d", c, n.vs)
		for _, k := range posKinds(anchor) {
			text := k.member
			if n.nmembers > 0 {
				text = "," + text
			}
			out = append(out, spellCase{where + ":" + k.name, []ByteEdit{{At: n.closeAt, Ins: ins(text)}}})
		}
	}
	return out
}

func receiptPosCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	shard, shards := 0, 1
	if v := os.Getenv("XTS_SHARD"); v != "" {
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(v, "%d/%d", &shard, &shards); err != nil || shards < 1 || shard < 0 || shard >= shards {
			return fmt.Errorf("XTS_SHARD %q: want i/n", v)
		}
	}
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "StartIndex, EndIndex and End of a receipt at every place a genesis-link document carries one (the genesis link, the receipt, the anchor's receipt, every link, every anchors[*] receipt), given every kind of value: judged by VerifyPortable from the text. No verifier reads these three fields: the receipt is judged by Start, Entries and Anchor alone."}
	bases, err := genesisBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sort.Strings(bases)
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStableCounting(raw, new(int), new(int))
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	byV := map[string]int{}
	seq := 0
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		for _, c := range receiptPosCases(docs[bi]) {
			if seq++; (seq-1)%shards != shard {
				continue
			}
			text := applyEdits(docs[bi], c.edits)
			lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
			ex, ok := judgeSweep(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
			if !ok {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s [%s] %s%s\n", bpath, c.name, lastPanic, lastFlaky)
				continue
			}
			byV[ex.V]++
			f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("receiptpos:%s:%s", bpath, c.name), Base: bi, Op: "receiptpos " + c.name[strings.LastIndex(c.name, ":")+1:], Edits: c.edits, Expect: ex})
		}
	}
	fmt.Printf("receiptpos shard %d/%d: %d bases, %d cases %v, skipped %+v\n", shard, shards, len(bases), len(f.Cases), byV, f.Skipped)
	return writeJSON(filepath.Join(out, fmt.Sprintf("bytes-cases-receiptpos-%d.json.gz", shard)), f)
}
